brief:
Israeli occupation forces have continued deploying armed quadcopter drones to strike Palestinian civilians in Gaza following the ceasefire, the Euro-Mediterranean Human Rights Monitor reported. The organization documented at least 60 civilian deaths in the aftermath, a toll that includes children caught in the strikes, according to Shehab Wire.

The use of armed drones against civilian populations has drawn scrutiny from human rights monitors tracking developments in Gaza. The documented incidents represent a continuation of aerial operations despite the agreed ceasefire, raising questions about compliance with the terms of the truce and protections for noncombatants in the territory.
